title: 20th Century / Modern
description: Revise concepts associated with 20th Century / Modern up to Higher. These features and forms may also occur in other periods.

items.prompt: A style using short repeating patterns which change gradually through processes such as phasing, adding notes or layering parts.
Music with no established tonal centre and no functional major or minor key.
A dense chord made from adjacent or very closely spaced notes sounded together.
A six-note scale built entirely from whole-tone steps, with no semitones.
Give the general term for different rhythmic groupings sounding simultaneously, rather than one particular three-against-two ratio.
Name the late-19th- and early-20th-century French style associated with Debussy, atmospheric tone colour, modal or whole-tone writing and parallel harmony.
A fusion of jazz harmony and improvisation with funk rhythm.
Music constructed from recorded real-world sounds rather than only conventional instruments.
Metres with an unusual number or grouping of beats, such as 5/4, 5/8, 7/8 or 7/4.
The time signature changes during the music, altering the number or grouping of beats and sometimes unsettling the pulse.
Two independent parts divide the same span evenly into three notes and two notes respectively. Name the cross-rhythm ratio, rather than a single-line tuplet.
Give the Italian term for a short repeating musical pattern, also called a riff.
Name the general musical device of restating a phrase or section unchanged.
Rhythmic emphasis is placed on weak beats, off-beats or notes held across strong beats.
